dct_description_sm: This GIS dataset depicts the surficial geology of the Haig River area (NTS 84E/NE) (GIS data, polygon features). The data were created in geodatabase format and output for public distribution in shapefile format. These data comprise the polygon features of Alberta Geological Survey Map 575, Surficial Geology of the Haig River Area (NTS 84E/NE).
dct_title_s: Surficial Geology of the Haig River Area (NTS 84E/NE) (GIS data, polygon features)
